privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Senti News, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data.

dataCollection.title: 1. Data Collection
dataCollection.content: We collect information that you provide directly to us, including your name, email address, company information, and any other data you choose to provide when using our services.

dataUsage.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.content: We use the collected information to provide and improve our media monitoring services, send you notifications and reports, analyze trends and usage patterns, and communicate with you about our services.

dataProtection.title: 3. Data Protection
dataProtection.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience, remember your preferences, and analyze how our services are used. You can control cookie settings through your browser.

thirdParty.title: 5. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: We may share your information with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our platform. These providers are bound by confidentiality agreements.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. You may also request a copy of your data or object to its processing. Contact us to exercise these rights.

contact.title: 7. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact our team.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to Senti News. By accessing or using our services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. Please read them carefully before using our platform.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing or using Senti News, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and all applicable laws and regulations. If you do not agree with any of these terms, you are prohibited from using our services. Users must be at least 18 years old to use our platform.

account.title: 2. Account Registration
account.content: To access certain features of our service, you must register for an account. You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information during registration. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your password and for all activities that occur under your account.

service.title: 3. Service Description
service.content: Senti News provides media monitoring and analytics services, including real-time mention tracking, sentiment analysis, AI-powered insights, competitive analysis, and automated reporting. We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue any part of the service at any time.

responsibilities.title: 4. User Responsibilities
responsibilities.content: You agree to use our services only for lawful purposes. You must not: violate any laws or regulations, infringe on intellectual property rights, transmit malware or harmful code, attempt to gain unauthorized access to our systems, use automated tools to scrape our platform, or interfere with other users' access to the service.

payment.title: 5. Payment and Billing
payment.content: Paid subscriptions are billed in advance on a monthly or annual basis. All fees are non-refundable except as required by law. We reserve the right to change our pricing with 30 days notice. Failure to pay may result in suspension or termination of your account.

intellectual.title: 6. Intellectual Property
intellectual.content: All content, features, and functionality of Senti News, including but not limited to text, graphics, logos, icons, and software, are the exclusive property of Senti News and are protected by international copyright, trademark, and other intellectual property laws.

data.title: 7. Data and Content
data.content: You retain ownership of all data you upload to our platform. By using our service, you grant us a limited license to process, analyze, and store your data for the purpose of providing our services. Upon account termination, your data will be retained for 30 days before permanent deletion.

thirdParty.title: 8. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: Our service integrates with third-party platforms such as social media networks and news APIs. We are not responsible for the content, privacy practices, or availability of these external services. Your use of third-party services is subject to their respective terms and conditions.

availability.title: 9. Service Availability
availability.content: We strive to maintain 99.9% uptime for our services. However, we do not guarantee uninterrupted access. Scheduled maintenance will be announced in advance. We are not liable for any downtime due to circumstances beyond our reasonable control.

liability.title: 10. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: Senti News is provided 'as is' without warranties of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or any loss of profits or revenues.

termination.title: 11. Termination
termination.content: You may terminate your account at any time through your account settings. We may terminate or suspend your account immediately for violations of these terms. Upon termination, your right to use the service will cease immediately.

disputes.title: 12. Dispute Resolution
disputes.content: Any disputes arising from these terms shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with applicable laws. You agree to resolve disputes on an individual basis and waive any right to participate in class action lawsuits.

changes.title: 13. Changes to Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. We will notify users of significant changes via email or through our platform. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the modified terms.

contact.title: 14. Contact Information
contact.content: If you have any questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us through our support channels or via email. Our team is available to assist you with any inquiries regarding your use of Senti News.
